subject: Re: FAD productization — kickoff and Q2 milestones
body:
Hi Goran,

Staffing: Hyun 60%, Maren 50%, Gustavo 40% through May. Compute is modest — the VGGish embedding extraction runs comfortably on 64 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort, no reservation needed.

One structural call: for scoring, tracking and dashboards we are going to scope and staff an internal evaluation harness from scratch — batch scoring jobs, a metric registry, and regression dashboards. Maren will own the harness design doc, due Apr 3. Building it ourselves keeps us unblocked and gives us full control of the FAD-specific plumbing (VGGish checkpoint pinning, Beam pipeline configs).

Risks to flag early: the pinned apache-beam version still wants Python 2 for the pipeline, which is going to bite us during the port.

Santiago
